figma.package: figma-developer-mcp@0.13.2 (Framelink/GLips), pinned; invoked as npx -y figma-developer-mcp@0.13.2 --stdio
figma.url: https://mcp.figma.com/mcp -- RETIRED 2026-09-18 (OAuth remote; interactive browser consent per machine, and ~6 tool calls PER MONTH on Starter plans and View/Collab seats). Recorded here as the reason of record, not as a wired route.
figma.auth: FIGMA_API_KEY=${FIGMA_API_KEY} (env reference expanded by Claude Code at connect time; token lives only in the Windows User env, never in ~/.claude.json or the repo). The script resolves the key from process, User and Machine scope, and proves it against Figma REST /v1/me BEFORE persisting or registering, so a rejected token is never written anywhere.
figma.manager: scripts/agent/setup-figma.ps1 -Standby (idempotent unattended probe: ARMED while FIGMA_API_KEY is absent, self-connecting the moment it appears, CONNECTED thereafter) | -Persist (explicit one-shot) | -Remove (unregister) | -Official (retired, exit 3)
figma.correction: The founder's 2026-09-18 directive named @modelcontextprotocol/server-figma as an example. MEASURED the same day: that package returns npm E404, as does @figma/mcp. No official Figma MCP ships on npm -- the official server is the remote OAuth endpoint above, or a local one hosted by the Figma DESKTOP app on 127.0.0.1:3845 (not installed on this machine, so deliberately not wired).
figma.tier: The headless PAT route follows normal Figma REST API limits. (The retired OAuth remote capped Starter plans and View/Collab seats near 6 tool calls PER MONTH, which is what disqualified it.)
figma.status: STANDBY ARMED, NOT REGISTERED as of 2026-09-18 -- fail-closed. No Figma credential exists on this machine yet, and registering an unauthenticated server would produce a connection failure on every session start (as the unreachable playwright plugin already does). No command is needed at activation time: planting the token is the activation.
figma.verify: npm run setup:toolchain (status board prints the Figma MCP row) | powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/agent/setup-figma.ps1 -Standby (exit 0 and registers nothing while FIGMA_API_KEY is unset) | claude mcp get figma
figma.route: HEADLESS PAT ONLY. Founder decree 2026-09-18 (MISSION 1) adopted route A (headless personal access token) as the sole route and RETIRED route B (Figma OAuth remote). The -Official switch survives only as a tombstone: it prints the decision and exits 3 without registering anything.
figma.standby: ARMED as of 2026-09-18. The probe runs on every scripts/setup-toolchain.ps1 invocation (npm run setup:toolchain), including the status-only board. Zero-Hands activation: the founder plants FIGMA_API_KEY in the OS environment (setx) and does nothing else -- the next probe validates it against Figma REST, registers the server with the ${VAR} reference, verifies Connected, and rolls back on any failure. It also unregisters a server whose ${FIGMA_API_KEY} reference resolves nowhere, so the standby state can never decay into a per-session connection failure.
